create_allegro_hand_robot: create a pyrobot Robot instance for the allegro_hand hardware platform
open_close_gripper: open and close the allegro hand gripper using the gripper open and close methods
set_gripper_joint_positions: set the allegro hand gripper joint positions using a numpy array of angles
read_gripper_joint_state: read the allegro hand gripper joint angles and velocities from the hardware
set_gripper_primitive_motion: set the allegro hand gripper primitive motion mode such as pinch_it or gravcomp
